Senses.Explanation: The whole teaching of one lifetime — forty-nine years and three hundred sixty assemblies gathered into one pile, then weighed by the Chan answers that would rather say it to one, quote the primer's first line, or call the whole thing a worn straw sandal. The case core. A monk asks Muzhou Daoming: what is the whole teaching of one lifetime? He answers: top-great-man, Q-Yi-Ji — the first characters a child learns to write, set against the whole canon. Yuanwu Keqin, commenting on the twin case in the Blue Cliff Record: a monk asks Yunmen the same; Yunmen says — say it to one. The school's stream, wanting to know the point of the buddha-nature, must watch the season and conditions; this is called the transmission outside the teaching, the mind-seal singly handed down, pointing straight at the mind for seeing the nature. Old Sakyamuni, forty-nine years in the world, three hundred sixty assemblies, opening the talk on sudden and gradual, provisional and real — call it the whole teaching of one lifetime. This monk lifts it up to ask: what is it? Why did Yunmen not explain it all for him, instead telling him — say it to one? And Wuzu Fayan, raising the same case in the hall: the monk asks Yunmen; Yunmen says — say it to one. Says the master: say it to one — it rolls up the whole five thousand forty-eight; wind, flowers, snow, and moon let themselves be handed down; behind the vajra head, raw iron is added. Zhongfeng Mingben, in the mountain-hut night talks, marks the pile as the learner's trap: the second kind of relapse — or else one takes the whole teaching of one lifetime as proclaimed by the Buddha's own mouth — since my work on the bearing phrase is not quick, I cannot but trace the lines and count the ink, planting good seeds as I go, telling myself none of it is wasted — all of it, he rules, is deserting right faith and wandering to the far shore of the odd arts. And Hanyue Fazang, lying pillowed on stone in the pines, hands the preaching to the ten thousand sights: clouds blaze, water and stone clash, the Vairocana body shows, the broad long tongue comes out — days called di-lan, days called a-bu-shi, days when the fourth-month sudden clearing makes the mountain colors good, one first dawn and the bird-sounds multiply — none of this is within the jurisdiction of the whole teaching of one lifetime; today the ten directions speak as mouth — mountain-say, water-say, empty-say, being-say, the living and lifeless of three times all turning the wheel together, so that hearers and seers stand on the spot and become buddhas. Lianyue Daozheng, at the twelfth-month eighth-day assembly: year after year the eighth of the last month, the praise is spoken — wonder of wonders — only because the morning star appeared, and the blind donkey is ever the womb of trouble. Old Sakyamuni saw through the one point of morning star in the sky; the morning star in the sky shone through old Sakyamuni's face; today's offering to the buddha and feeding of the assembly — the layman Yang already became buddha together at the moment of seeing the star, and the whole great earth's people before me too. Back then he saw it so thoroughly, walked out of the snow mountains, and with that one point of morning star fixed the world's faces: after the way was seen, the gates of conduct were built without edge — three hundred-odd assemblies of sutra-talk, forty-nine years of preaching, completing the whole teaching of one lifetime; but to the correct eye it looks most like an eye-film in the eye, flowers falling in empty sky. Does anyone breathe on Sakyamuni's behalf? If so, he shares one nostril with him; if not, the wide-heir tongue is left idly wagging — Pa! And Yushan Shangsi, after the catechism of true buddha, true way: the whole teaching of one lifetime — on inspection, what is it but a worn straw sandal? A great-spirited man never leans on it for his understanding: sometimes the shout that scatters white-cloud vapors, sometimes the tongs that break open the hammer of empty sky — not only the three worthies blanched and the ten stages startled: even if old Sakyamuni himself came, he too would be chased off to some other world; only then does one count as a man no delusion can hold.
